description: Defines the Diagnosis entity class for the OpenMRS healthcare system, including fields, relationships, and metadata related to patient diagnoses during healthcare encounters.

classes.name: Diagnosis
classes.description: Entity class representing a patient's diagnosis in the healthcare system, including references to encounter, condition, patient, diagnosis details, certainty, and related attributes.

methods.name: Diagnosis
methods.description: Default constructor for creating an empty Diagnosis instance.

methods.name: Diagnosis
methods.description: Overloaded constructor for initializing a Diagnosis with encounter, diagnosis, certainty, rank, and patient.

methods.name: Diagnosis
methods.description: Overloaded constructor for initializing a Diagnosis with additional form namespace and path information.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of this diagnosis.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for this diagnosis.

methods.name: getDiagnosisId
methods.description: Retrieves the diagnosis database ID.

methods.name: setDiagnosisId
methods.description: Sets the diagnosis database ID.

methods.name: getEncounter
methods.description: Gets the Encounter object associated with this diagnosis.

methods.name: setEncounter
methods.description: Assigns an Encounter object to this diagnosis.

methods.name: getDiagnosis
methods.description: Returns the diagnosis details, which could be coded or free text.

methods.name: setDiagnosis
methods.description: Sets the diagnosis details.

methods.name: getCertainty
methods.description: Gets the verification certainty status of the diagnosis.

methods.name: setCertainty
methods.description: Sets the verification certainty status.

methods.name: getRank
methods.description: Retrieves the rank/priority of the diagnosis.

methods.name: setRank
methods.description: Sets the rank/priority of the diagnosis.

methods.name: getCondition
methods.description: Returns the associated Condition object, if any.

methods.name: setCondition
methods.description: Associates a Condition with this diagnosis.

methods.name: getPatient
methods.description: Retrieves the Patient associated with this diagnosis.

methods.name: setPatient
methods.description: Associates a Patient with this diagnosis.

methods.name: getFormNamespaceAndPath
methods.description: Returns the combined form namespace and path string.

methods.name: setFormNamespaceAndPath
methods.description: Sets the form namespace and path string.

methods.name: getFormFieldNamespace
methods.description: Extracts and returns the namespace part from formNamespaceAndPath.

methods.name: getFormFieldPath
methods.description: Extracts and returns the path part from formNamespaceAndPath.

methods.name: setFormField
methods.description: Sets the namespace and path for form identification, combining them into formNamespaceAndPath.
